overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG makes no detections and correctly rejects all four negative segments; no hidden bias instances are missed because the control has none.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: No strict instance-level true positives are possible or observed because the hidden manifest contains zero instances. The low-confidence identified finding is a false positive when low confidence is included, and the two candidates add false positives at the candidate-inclusive threshold.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: The mechanism-first scorecard is identical to the strict scorecard for this zero-bias run: there are no hidden mechanisms to match, and all qualifying predictions are false positives.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidates appropriately preserve uncertainty in their wording, but on this zero-bias control they are not supported by the hidden ground truth and materially increase the false-alarm rate from 0.25 to 0.75 relative to the all-identified threshold.
main_failure_modes: Calling an ambiguous, professionally defensible precaution an availability heuristic at low confidence.
Adding speculative status quo and negativity-bias candidates on negative reasoning segments.
Reducing abstention as confidence thresholds broaden, producing false alarms on a zero-bias control.
main_strengths: All evidence quotes are valid and the identified finding is localized to the correct decision episode.
The RAG explicitly discloses that retrieved corpus support was unavailable and distinguishes identified findings from candidates.
At high and moderate confidence, the RAG correctly rejects every negative segment.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows perfect conservative segment-level rejection at high_and_moderate confidence, followed by a clear false-alarm increase when low-confidence findings and then candidates are admitted. The result supports using high_and_moderate as the primary comparison threshold for this control run.
